Market today: The S&P 500 is hitting new records, largely thanks to the "Magnificent Seven" tech giants. This bullish sentiment, coupled with strong signals from the chip sector (Marvell, AI energy crunch), is driving your tech and chip-heavy portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -26.91% with a "SELL" status and known decay. SPAL is also down -12.64% with a "WATCH" status, leveraged, and near its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, MSFU) for any signs of weakness or if they approach their stops. Also, monitor the overall tech/chip sector for sustained momentum.

Bottom line: While the market is strong, your leveraged losses demand immediate attention to protect capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or selling this leveraged position. It's down -26.91% with a "SELL" status and decays, making it a high-risk holding on margin.
SPAL: Watch closely. It's down -12.64% and near its stop of 21.38. Be ready to exit if it breaks that level.
AMD: Consider adding. Scanner shows ACCUMULATE at entry 648.77-648.12, stop 647.15, backed by strong chip sector news.
